text:
maria: Heads up — finance flagged a ~1.2x GPU bill blip for Feb/Mar. Looks like spot churn + missed reserved credits. I'm proposing a short reserved commit to stabilize run rate. need quick input (cost + capacity).

alex: how big a commit are you thinking? and region?

maria: thinking 20 H100-equivalents for 3 months in us-west-2 as a pilot. rough numbers below. want to validate tags + credits first. :thinking_face:

maria: ```
rough calc (monthly):
- on-demand/spot avg cost: $280k
- reserved 20 GPUs @ $8k/mo = $160k
- delta = $120k saved/mo (~43%) but depends on utilization
```

david: 43% seems high vs marketplace numbers, are we including egress/network + burst premiums? eu-west capacity is tight rn, so shifting eu traffic to us-west could add cross-region egress.

juan: also found a bunch of untagged infra VMs. billing-bot just dumped an alert. if credits weren't applied because of tagging mismatch that explains the anomaly.

billing-bot: ALERT: Detected $47,182 untagged GPU spend on account infra-prod between timestamps 1790370000-1790450000. Missing tags: team, cost-center. Recommend: tag + re-run credit reconciliation.

ekaterina: proposal: do a hybrid commit — 12 reserved in us-west-2 (stable baseline), keep 8 as spot/burst across regions. Run for 8 weeks, measure realized $/GPU-hr and preemption impact.

alex: can we get a quick monte-carlo using last 90 days utilization? i.e., model realized savings at 70/80/95% utilization.

maria: yes — i'll run a simple model and post results by EOD. sample input i'll use: avg util=78%, preempt rate for spot=12%, cross-region egress delta=+$6k/mo.

juan: action item: I will tag the untagged instances today and open a ticket with cloud billing to reconcile missed credits.

sam: finance: we can approve up to $200k/mo additional committed spend for a pilot, but need 1) model + risks, 2) rollback plan, 3) owner for the commit.

david: owner for the pilot should be infra-costs@team — whoever runs the autoscaler config. also we should set automated fallback to smaller instance types if utilization drops.

maria: agreed. initial owner = maria. rollback plan: convert reserved to shorter-term commit if available; or scale down via dedicated pools.

ekaterina: quick note on capacity: I checked provider inventory — us-west-2 has the H100 pool but not enough for >30 in short notice. 12 is safe; 20 might require lead time or cross-region placement.

alex: cool. maria, when you post the model can you include a line-item for tagging reconciliation savings? that might reduce the needed commit.

maria: will do. Plan for today: 1) juan tags resources, 2) billing ticket opened, 3) i run cost model + post results by 6pm PT, 4) esketch commit sizes + region constraints.

sam: once model is in we'll fast-track approval meeting (15m). :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will ping #exec-ops if numbers look good.

alex: ack

david: ack

(threads ends)
